g.text: shim for SoF 1 servers: loads the stock game DLL and detours engine/game code by data
Core · one shim, many patched call sites
gameplay events · usercmd · ClientCommand · map spawn
`gamex86.cpp` — load `oldgamex86.dll`, forward `GetGameAPI`, undo patches on unload
`DetourSystem` — resolve RVA by module, build trampoline, patch, strip on detach
`stufftext` · stable — console command → `svc_stufftext` to one/all clients
`print_guard` · stable — bound engine printf / Cbuf / macro paths
`sv_tracktime` · stable — compare claimed `msec` with real `clc_move` rate
`clsv_pipe` · unstable — chunked `.sp`/`.func` delivery over the client cvar ring
`minigames` · unstable — client 2D UI, menus, lagometer, tictactoe
`profiles` · unstable — GUID identity, roster privileges, match stats
`skinteam_quiet` · unstable — stop the false "doesn't recognise teamname" message
`cpuopt · tick_pacing` — spin to the 100 ms tick boundary
`cpuopt · cmdtext_parking` — park `cmd_text` inserts in the reserve window
`cpuopt · cbuf_insert` — shift the command buffer in place
`cpuopt · clamp_monitor` — count high/low clock clamps, optional log + broadcast
`reliable_defer` · experimental — queue reliable blobs, drip one per client per tick
`ctf_spawn` · experimental — pick the team spawn farthest from living enemies
`build/gamex86.dll` — the one file an admin installs
`SoF-spsv.exe` / `SoF.exe` — engine frame loop, cvar/command tables, netchan
SoFplus scripts — drive `Cbuf_InsertText` and bursty prints
GitHub Actions — per-branch build + release zip
hash maps · zpool free lists · per-slot profile cache
